raw_segments.text: These are the women who are amused by the reveries of the stupid novelists, who, knowing
little of human nature, work up stale tales, and describe meretricious scenes, all retailed
in a sentimental jargon, which equally tend to corrupt the taste and draw the heart aside
I do not mention the understanding, because never having been exercised, its slumbering
